# Round intent

1. Read the whole tabletop state and initiative order.
2. Form one shared objective for the monster side this round.
3. Include every required creature exactly once, using its visible name and numbered badge.
4. Give each creature one action intent, a direct target or area anchor when relevant, and a destination only when movement matters.
5. Use an exact gutter label only for a destination or area anchor. Otherwise describe position relative to a visible named creature or object.
6. Give a short tactical reason without restating hidden mechanics or inventing state.

An omitted destination means hold position. An exact gutter label overrides a relative destination. The game rules determine legality and outcomes after the intent is expressed.
